Blackberry Powder Price: Spray Dried Blackberry Powder for Food Manufacturers

Looking for a fair blackberry powder price without giving up on quality? Tradenest Naturals supplies spray dried blackberry powder for food and beverage manufacturers who care about flavour and colour. Blackberries have a rich, sweet-tart taste and a dark purple colour. Our spray drying process captures that character in a fine powder that dissolves quickly. This makes it a practical ingredient for B2B buyers in North America, the UK and Europe who need a dry, easy-to-store fruit ingredient.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Berry Powder?

As a blackberry powder exporter, we know that consistency keeps your production line running. That is why we use a controlled spray drying process. Fast drying helps keep the natural colour, aroma and flavour of the fruit. As a result, your finished products keep their vivid colour and berry taste. Whether you need wholesale blackberry powder for drinks or blackberry fruit powder bulk for confectionery, our powder is stable and easy to use.

Careful Processing & Quality

We are a dedicated blackberry powder manufacturer and handle each step ourselves. First, we use blackberries carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Second, the fruit is cleaned and sorted to remove stems and foreign matter. Third, the juice is spray dried into a fine, uniform powder. Finally, each lot is checked for moisture, colour and particle size. We follow written hygienic handling procedures throughout. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. This is how our dehydrated blackberry powder wholesale supply stays consistent shipment after shipment. The exact composition, including any drying carrier used, is stated in the product specification sheet.

Versatile Applications in Modern Food Production

Our blackberry powder for food industry use covers a wide range of products. Beverage companies use it in instant fruit drinks and smoothies. Confectioners use it for natural colour and flavour in gummies and hard candies. Bakeries add it to fillings, frostings and glazes. Because it dissolves easily, it also works well in yogurt, ice cream and other dairy products. As a bulk blackberry powder supplier, we help you develop new products with confidence.

Detailed Product Specifications

We share our technical parameters openly. Our standard specifications are:
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh for good solubility.
  • Moisture Content: < 5% for stability in storage.
  • Processing: Spray dried from blackberry juice.
  • Solubility: Dissolves readily in water and acidic liquids.

Frequently Asked Questions for B2B Buyers

What is the minimum order quantity for blackberry powder price quotes? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. Trial quantities for R&D are welcome, and larger orders receive volume pricing. Contact us for a quote based on your needs. What documents and quality standards apply? We are an FSSAI licensed food business and IEC registered exporter. Our records support batch traceability. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We provide moisture-resistant export packaging, including bulk bags, HDPE containers and private label pouches. The shelf life is 18-24 months when stored correctly. How do I request a sample or quote? Send us a message through our inquiry form. Samples are available on request, and we will reply with pricing and technical details.

Partner with Tradenest Naturals

Tradenest Naturals is a manufacturer-exporter based in Surat, India. We combine careful processing with practical food know-how and honest communication. That lets us offer fair pricing and supply that grows with you. Whether you are a young D2C brand or a large food company, we offer OEM and private label packing and ship worldwide from India.
